name: Brock's List
summary: At Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker sends a list of mining pupils honored with picks from Ironforge's guild halls.

sections.title: A Miner's Distinction
sections.body: In Khaz Modan, apprentices must prove their skill before taking on serious work in the mines. Brock records those who excel in their lessons. He entrusts the list to travelers bound for Ironforge, where the honored names can be engraved on the picks.

sections.title: The Road to the Great Forge
sections.body: A gryphon carries Brock's List from Thelsamar's roost to Golnir Bouldertoe at the Deep Mountain Mining Guild in Ironforge's Great Forge. There, the students' names are engraved on their honorary picks.

faq.answer: Brock Stoneseeker, Thelsamar's mining instructor, writes a roster of apprentices who excel in their mining lessons and earn honorary picks.

faq.q: Who do I deliver Brock's List to?
aliases: where do i take the list
faq.answer: Show Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson, the gryphon master in Thelsamar, to arrange passage. Then carry it to Golnir Bouldertoe at the Deep Mountain Mining Guild in Ironforge's Great Forge.

faq.q: Why does Golnir Bouldertoe need this document?
aliases: why does ironforge need the list
faq.answer: Golnir Bouldertoe oversees the Deep Mountain Mining Guild's tools in Ironforge. He has honorary picks ready and needs Brock's roster to engrave each student's name on one.

faq.q: Why is the list sent by gryphon rather than foot?
faq.answer: The mountain passes through Loch Modan connect to Dun Morogh. A gryphon from Thorgrum Borrelson's roost carries the list swiftly and safely to the Great Forge.

angles.text: As a prospector, you can see that Brock's List honors apprentices who have earned a place in the Deep Mountain Mining Guild's traditions.
As a dwarf, you know the list honors young miners devoted to the pick and shovel beneath Khaz Modan.
